requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single functional requirement describing a system capability.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.

fields.affected_element: data-plane interfaces and management data traffic

structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switches shall have the ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: The core predicate is 'ability to filter' (a system capability/action). The structure is based on the explicit mention of the switch's function.

unsupported_inferences_avoided: Did not specify the exact filtering mechanism (e.g., based on protocol/port) as the requirement only states the *ability* to filter, not the *how*.
